name: Improved Rapid Shot
body:
You have learned ways to make your quick shots more accurate.

Prerequisite(s): Manyshot, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot.

Benefit(s): You ignore the -2 penalty to your ranged attack rolls from using the Rapid Shot feat.

Special: A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
